cases.scenario: Bottom-up forecast. Commit-tagged pipeline total = $8.1M; in-window segment close rate = 78%. Compute the commit value = commit-tagged pipeline x in-window close rate. State the single figure in $M to three decimals.
cases.source: Bottom-up forecast construction: commit = sum(commit-tagged pipeline) x in-window close rate (standard finance/RevOps forecasting).

check.rationale: 8.1 x 0.78 = 6.318 ($M). Step 1 bottom-up: sum commit-tagged x in-window close-rate per segment.

cases.scenario: Top-down forecast. Total addressable market (TAM) = $4.2B; expected penetration = 0.6%. Compute the top-down ARR = TAM x penetration. State the single figure in $M.
cases.source: Top-down forecast construction: ARR = TAM x penetration band (x motion band) (standard market-sizing).

check.rationale: 4,200,000,000 x 0.006 = 25,200,000 = $25.2M. Step 1 top-down: TAM x penetration band.
